children: Genius said all new tokens created on the Genius.fun platform will have contract addresses ending in “6666,” giving the tokens a uniform identifying signature. According to Odaily, Genius said the “6” represents good fortune and smooth progress and also corresponds to the letter “G” in the Genius brand, with the aim of strengthening the platform’s token brand recognition.

title: Genius.fun Will End All New Token Contract Addresses With “6666”
